== Program.Main (line 3)
| Main(args)
  instruction
    | total := 0
  for style=COUNTER
    | for i := 0 to args.Length - 1
    # Count the arguments.
    -
      instruction
        | total := total + i
  instruction
    | Console.WriteLine(total)
